opening.argument: The presentation is structured around instruction in data science, business analysis, metrics, and career development. It explains that a Business Analyst supports “Marketing, operational, strategical and even management level,” and places statistical methods such as clustering and regression analysis within data-science study. The discussion also addresses strategic decisions as longer-term planning, while the visible Funnel Chart presents ordinary stages from viewing a homepage through signing up and purchasing. These materials describe professional concepts and operational measurement. The Bukalapak app and support references function as publisher branding, and nothing described requests payment or credentials, makes a deceptive promise, or directs a harmful transaction.
